profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at MSUFCU
profile.summary:
Systems and Communications Engineer with over 8 years of experience developing  applications in diverse industries including energy services, financial services and systems consulting services. 

Expertise in Microsoft technologies as .NET Core, ASP.NET, Power BI, Power Apps, in conjunction with different data sources, relational SQL Databases and Azure services. Development and implementation of Web Services and API’s SOAP/REST. Interaction with source control systems GIT, SVN. Strong experience working as full stack developer with programming languages such as C#, Java, Power On and scripting Languages (Jquery, JavaScript, CSS, TypeScript, HTML)

positions.title: Admin Support Engineer
positions.description: Support Data Center to notify customers of rig activity during oil extraction in real time.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: Support global applications serving international users and working remotely with India team developing new web application projects in .NET technologies, MS SQL Server and Oracle Databases.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description: Support and installation of network communication/data acquisition system to track critical data in oilfield jobs delivering information in real time for customers.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Develop and support incidents applications in Visual Basic .Net for Legacy ERP system.
